The screen prominently displays the text "INMODE SUMMIT 2025" and features two high-resolution facial comparison photos of a woman showing significant improvement in skin texture and reduced acne inflammation. The stage floor has a subtle green glow at the edge, and the overall atmosphere is professional and high-tech. (2) The presentation on the LED screen transitions to show a close-up, fluorescent blue-tinted image of a human face, specifically highlighting the forehead and nose area to illustrate changes in the skin's microbiome. The female speaker remains positioned on the left side of the frame, maintaining eye contact with an unseen audience while her left hand moves in sync with her speech. The lighting remains constant, with the bright screen serving as the primary light source in the background, while the presenter herself is well-lit by overhead stage spots. (3) The visual slides change again, now presenting a front-facing comparison of a woman with red, irritated skin, with her eyes and mouth partially obscured by white rectangular bars for privacy. The presenter stands next to the screen, her posture confident as she points out specific details of the treatment results. To the right of the screen, a small part of another facial photo is visible, suggesting a multi-frame display. The setting remains a large event hall, evidenced by the scale of the screen and the professional stage setup. (4) In the final visual phase, the screen displays a comparison of a man's face, focusing on the reduction of rosacea symptoms after treatment. The female presenter continues her lecture, holding the microphone close to her mouth as she speaks with focused intensity. The camera angle is steady and eye-level, capturing the full figure of the presenter against the backdrop of the informative medical slides. The visual rhythm is slow, dictated by the pace of the informational slides being presented.
